theme_and_archetype.reasoning: This is a delivery route optimization app built for drivers in the field. Dark theme minimizes glare, saves battery, and ensures high visibility of critical data (stops, statuses) using a dark canvas with high-contrast accent colors like orange, green, and red.

typography.rules: Avoid Inter for headings. Use Manrope for its strong, utilitarian feel, perfectly suited for a driver dashboard. IBM Plex Sans provides excellent legibility for complex addresses and data.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first, gesture-driven. Focus on large touch targets for drivers using the app with one hand or mounted on a dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all actionable items (buttons, list rows, map markers).

buttons.primary: Solid #ea580c background, bold white text, rounded-xl, no shadow to maintain flat performance look.
buttons.outline: Transparent background, 1px solid border matching text color, rounded-xl.

cards.stop_widget: Floating dark card over map. bg-[#171717], border border-[#333333], shadow-xl, rounded-2xl.
cards.list_item: bg-transparent, border-b border-[#333333], py-4. High contrast title (address), subtle subtitle (client info/code).

inputs.text: bg-[#171717], border border-[#333333], rounded-xl, px-4 py-3 text-white. Focus state: border border-[#ea580c].

bottom_action_bar.description: Fixed at the bottom of the active route screen. Contains stops counter and primary actions.

setup_upload.layout: Centered content. Huge 'Upload List' dropzone or button.
setup_upload.elements: File type badges (PDF, Excel, CSV, TXT), Manual Entry text button, and Camera Scanner button. Emphasize the ease of starting.

active_route.layout: Split screen: Map on top (flex-1), Draggable bottom sheet or Scrollable list for stops (flex-1).
active_route.map: Dark mode map style. Polyline color: #3b82f6. Numbered markers (Orange for pending, Green for delivered, Red for failed).
active_route.list: Swipeable rows or clear tap targets to open details. Status indicators on each row.

stop_detail_widget.layout: Floating card overlaid on the map or expanded from the bottom sheet.
stop_detail_widget.elements: Full address, client name, package code (Shopee/Mercado Livre), large action buttons.

scanner.layout: Full screen camera view with a dark semi-transparent overlay and a clear scanning frame in the center.
scanner.elements: Flashlight toggle, close button, manual entry fallback button.

paywall.layout: High impact conversion screen. Premium feel.
paywall.elements: App logo/icon, value proposition ('Otimize suas rotas', 'Menos de R$1 por dia'). Big typography for 'R$20/mês'. Generate PIX QR code dynamically using 'react-native-qrcode-svg'. Provide 'Copiar Código PIX' button.

onboarding_bg.description: Delivery driver checking phone, use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70) for onboarding or login screen.

motion_and_interaction.transitions: Fast and snappy (0.2s duration). Delivery drivers do not have time for long animations.
motion_and_interaction.haptics: Provide haptic feedback on 'Delivered' and 'Failed' button presses (via React Native Haptics if possible).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over map and buttons meets APCA minimums.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="mark-delivered-btn"`, `data-testid="upload-file-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native / Expo components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, etc.).
Do NOT use HTML tags (div, span) since this is a React Native app.
IMPORTANT: Write code using .js file extensions, not .tsx. You have .js files.
For routing, use expo-router or react-navigation.
For the map, use react-native-maps. Configure it with a dark mode JSON style. Ensure real geocoding via OpenStreetMap Nominatim API as requested.
For QR Code generation on the PIX screen, install and use 'react-native-qrcode-svg' with the provided CNPJ (48.223.054/0001-42).
Implement the UI text strictly in Portuguese (pt-BR).
Implement local storage of routes (AsyncStorage or equivalent).
